scope: Coffey natural-source-order strict-prefix path after a complement certificate at U=C n^(5/3) log^2 n; no claim about all RH approaches.
statement: Once the complement is superpolynomially negligible at the smaller R9 cutoff, the local-to-global bottleneck is no longer the tail estimate. The unresolved obstruction is to obtain a target-domain, source-order one-sided constraint on the strict-prefix statistic Q_n(Y_n), with arithmetic applicability/attainability strong enough to change the Li lower-bound ledger but demonstrably weaker than endpoint/root control.
why_reusable: Future prefix, block, mollifier, or resonance routes must not count an ambient signed-path DifferenceWitness as fixed-zeta arithmetic attainability, and must separately show that their gluing obligation does not reconstruct the endpoint/root-sensitive load.
